name: PhoneCursor
summary: A smartphone used as a 3D controller for AR headsets: the phone's motion moves a cursor and touch confirms.
howItWorks: The user moves the phone to steer a cursor in the AR scene and uses the touchscreen to refine and select, improving on head-gaze selection.
